payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the mug been moved toward and to the right of the headphones?
node.criteria: Complete if the mug has been moved from its source position and is to the right of the headphones in the edited image. Partial if there is visible progress moving the mug toward the right of the headphones but it has not reached a position to their right. Absent if there is no visible progress toward that requested placement. Unknown if the images do not provide sufficient evidence to assess the mug's movement and placement. Do not count merely finding a mug to the right as progress unless the images support that it is the mug being moved; do not require that no duplicate or remnant be visible.
node.binding: The mug in the source image and the headphones in the source and edited images; assess the requested mug placement by comparing source and edited images.

outcome.description: Move the mug to the right of the headphones.
